title: Ceramics Classes - Gas Reduction Firing
source_quote: The ceramic studio incorporates 18 wheels, 5 electric and 4 gas reduction kilns, 1 raku and saggar, and a soda kiln with a dedicated teaching team.
how_to_join: Enroll at Mendocino College for the semester (last day to add: Jan 29, 2027).

summary: Mendocino College ceramics students can take courses using the college's four gas reduction kilns. Enroll in the Associate of Arts in Ceramics or Master Technician Certificate program.
evidence_sentence: The ceramics department lists 4 gas reduction kilns as studio equipment for student use.
